d: Across uncharted oceans, subterranean tomb chambers, and desolate desert ruins, ancient legends hold the clues to humanity's greatest forgotten treasures. In this expansive multi-season expedition, join archaeologist and adventurer Josh Gates on a relentless quest unearthing holy relics, sunken wonders, and lost civilizations that vanished centuries ago. From deep-sea archaeological dives exploring submerged ports to treacherous underground treks inside hidden subterranean vaults, Gates works alongside local historians, utilizing ground-penetrating radar, marine sonar, and remote sensing…
